name: Week Load
summary: Is next week over-committed? Hours booked and the day-by-day load.
description: Answers whether next week is over-committed before it fills up. Sums the booked hours the calendar bridge reports for the next seven days, draws the day-by-day load as a sparkline and lists the busiest days. The bridge currently reports only the day view, so the hours and load bindings can render blank until it exposes per-day load; the card never guesses hours.
highlights: Hours booked next week from the calendar bridge
A 14-day load sparkline, never more than 30 points
Busiest days first, with back-to-back counts
